Actor Rajpal Yadav Sentenced to Jail by Delhi High Court

The Delhi High Court has sentenced actor Rajpal Yadav to three months in jail for cheque bounce cases. The court rejected his appeal, upholding his conviction. The sentence includes a fine, and Yadav will be taken into custody.
